description: Retrieve InterPro and member-signature matches on one PDB entry's protein chains. Each chain record keeps match locations in chain numbering (1-based start/end beside author auth_start/auth_end, which can be null), in UniProt numbering, and the chain-to-UniProt residue map, with discontinuous fragments preserved; the UniProt protein is null for unmapped chains. InterPro nests at most 20 chain records per match; set chain to read one chain completely. Budgeted segments hold whole matches; the first carries structure metadata listing the protein chains. Continue coverage.nextCursor until hasMore is false.

chain.description: Protein chain to map, case-sensitive and one of structure.chains, such as A; omit for every chain.

cursor.description: Opaque coverage.nextCursor with unchanged pdbId and chain.

pdbId.description: Four-character PDB ID such as 1tsr; case-insensitive. Extended pdb_0000… IDs are not supported.

name: interpro_get_structure_domains

cap.description: Most matches one call reads; a segment can stop sooner at the response byte budget.

chain.description: Chain the map is restricted to, when one was set.

coverage.description: Where this segment sits in the structure map.

complete.description: True only when this call starts without a cursor and returns every match.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor resuming at the next whole match for the same pdbId and chain.

returnedMatches.description: Whole matches in this segment; totalMatches is upstream's reported count, and a complete walk can return a different number.

totalMatches.description: Upstream total match count for the structure, or for the chain when one is set.

effectiveQuery.description: Applied pdbId and chain as JSON.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `structure_not_found`: InterPro has no current structure for the PDB ID: unassigned, obsolete, or not yet loaded. `entry_withdrawn`: InterPro reports the structure or its match list withdrawn with HTTP 410. `chain_not_found`: The chain is not one of the structure’s protein chains; IDs are case-sensitive and nucleic-acid chains are not listed. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The shared fifty-second budget expires across the structure metadata and match pages. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor decoding or scope fails, the page it resumes inside changed, or upstream rejects continuation. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, structure, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Whole matches in this segment, in upstream order; never split across segments.

items.description: Whole entry match; its chain records are in structures under its accession.

chainRecordCount.description: Chain records InterPro nested in this match, all returned in structures.

chainRecordLimitReached.description: True when the match carries InterPro’s 20-record nesting limit, so it may match chains not returned; set chain to read one chain.

sourceUrls.description: Official API URLs this call read.

structure.description: Complete upstream structure metadata on the first segment, the call without cursor; continuation segments omit it.

chains.description: Protein chain IDs; nucleic-acid chains are not listed.

structures.description: Every chain record of this segment’s matches, grouped by match in matches order.

items.description: One upstream chain record of a match, unchanged.

entry.description: Accession of the match in matches this record belongs to.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

entry_protein_locations.description: Match locations in UniProt numbering; null or empty without a usable mapping.

entry_structure_locations.description: Match locations in chain numbering: start/end are 1-based chain positions; auth_start/auth_end are author residue numbers, possibly null.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

protein.description: Lowercase UniProt accession mapped to the chain; null when unmapped.

items.description: Complete continuous or discontinuous sequence fragment.

structure_protein_locations.description: Chain-to-UniProt residue maps: start/end in chain numbering, protein_start/protein_end in UniProt numbering.

title: Map structure domains
